resources.string: Set the screen. Set the message. Hand over the magic.
Press START, then wipe the screen to reveal your message. Tap it to replay; long-press it to return here.
Your photos stay on this device. No network needed.
Message revealed. Tap to perform again. Long-press to return to setup.

No image picker is available on this device

1. Set Screen — the photo, lock screen or picture your audience sees first.

2. Set Message — the picture or note the wipe reveals.

3. Press START and hand the phone over. Ask them to wipe the screen with a finger.

Once the message appears, tap the screen to perform again. Long-press the message — or press Back — to return to this menu.

Everything is processed on this device and nothing is uploaded.
